name: The Mine Entrance
description: A short, quiet tunnel with three small chests and no monsters. The same every time: perfect for your first programs. Old rune tablets still lie in the dust here.

name: Old Mines, first floor
description: The same hand-made floor every time: two slimes, two skeletons, a spike trap and two chests. Golems will need to decide when to fight.

name: The Old Mines
description: A new floor for every seed: slimes, bats, skeletons, fire beetles and the odd troll. Chests hold 5 to 15 gold, and deeper runes wait between the veins.

name: The Deep Mines
description: Bigger floors, more trolls and fire beetles, and chests with 12 to 25 gold. The last and strangest runes are down here. Bring a party.
